title: Cleaning Operative
summary: Provide scheduled cleaning services at St George's University Hospital and help maintain a safe, welcoming environment. You will follow agreed routines, use cleaning materials correctly, maintain equipment, and meet service standards across designated areas. The role suits someone reliable and proactive who can work independently while contributing positively to the wider facilities team.
responsibilities: Follow the agreed cleaning schedule and service standards
Keep equipment clean, maintained, and safe to use
Use cleaning materials and chemicals in line with health and safety rules
Work independently and with the wider facilities team
required_qualifications: Ability to follow schedules and safety procedures
Ability to work independently and as part of a team
